fields.text: My partner keeps the promises they make to me.
I feel comfortable sharing my secrets with my partner.
My partner is honest with me even when it's difficult.
I trust my partner's intentions toward me.
We openly discuss our feelings and concerns.
My partner listens to me without interrupting.
We resolve disagreements calmly and respectfully.
I feel heard and understood by my partner.
I feel safe expressing my true feelings to my partner.
My partner respects my emotional boundaries.
I feel emotionally supported during hard times.
My partner validates my feelings even when they disagree.
My partner makes time for our relationship despite a busy schedule.
We make plans together and follow through on them.
My partner shows appreciation for the things I do.
We put equal effort into maintaining our relationship.
My partner celebrates my successes and achievements.
I feel supported in pursuing my personal goals.
My partner is there for me during difficult life events.
We encourage each other's growth and development.
My partner raises their voice or shouts during arguments.
My partner tries to control who I spend time with.
My partner makes me feel guilty for spending time with friends or family.
I feel like I am walking on eggshells around my partner.
My partner dismisses my feelings or tells me I'm overreacting.
